name: SegmentedControl
summary: Choose one option from a compact inline set.

a11y.apg: radio group. Single choice among a few visible options is a radio group, not a row of independent toggles — that was finding M20, closed by ADR-0016 on 07/08/2026. Each option is a <button role="radio"> with aria-checked, the group is one tab stop, and the arrows both move and select. The engine ships the pattern; the skin is ours.
a11y.keyboardNote: Re-measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: Home, End — absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect; a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not. Tab is not measurable here by construction: it moves focus anywhere on the page, so it never distinguishes one component from another. This note is NOT the one the other lineage carried: that one measured a role="group" row of aria-pressed buttons, and ADR-0016 replaced it with the engine's radio group. Keeping the old prose would have been a measurement of a component that no longer exists.

props.name: items
props.description: The options. Two to five: past that it is a Select, not a segmented control.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value. Controlled by design — one of many always has an owner.
